match: a 3D tetrahedron / triangular pyramid — labels like "3d tetra", "tetrahedron", "3d abcd", or a rough wireframe sketch of a four-faced pyramid with vertices A B C D
params: {"labels": true|false — A B C D vertex labels (default shown); "flat": true|false — start flattened/unfolded; "slice": true|false — open the slicing plane; "tilt": 0-180, "offset": -1.4..1.4, "spin": 0-360, "cut": "full"|"above"|"below"} — all optional
